tvShow.name: Task
tvShow.overview: In the working-class suburbs of Philadelphia, an FBI agent heads a task force assembled to put an end to a string of violent robberies led by an unsuspecting family man.

episodes.name: Crossings
episodes.overview: Forced back into the field after a family tragedy, Special Agent Tom Brandis leads a new Task Force investigating a string of robberies.

episodes.name: Family Statements
episodes.overview: As Tom's family braces for an emotional court date, Robbie faces a dilemma, and Maeve makes a critical choice.

episodes.name: Nobody's Stronger than Forgiveness
episodes.overview: As Robbie and Cliff try to find a potential buyer, Tom and Grasso level with the Dark Hearts, and Aleah and Lizzie question Peaches' former coworkers. Later, a raid leads Tom to a shocking revelation.

episodes.name: All Roads
episodes.overview: While Tom questions the loyalty of his Task Force, Perry probes his own gang for answers – and uncovers a shocking truth.

episodes.name: Vagrants
episodes.overview: With help from an eyewitness, Tom and his team inch closer to breaking the case. Perry pays Maeve a visit, while Robbie puts his plan in motion. Later, Tom follows a lead that takes him down a dangerous path.

episodes.name: Out beyond ideas of wrongdoing and rightdoing, there is a river.
episodes.overview: The Task Force, Dark Hearts, and Robbie converge in the woods, leading to a dramatic showdown with far-reaching consequences.

episodes.name: A Still Small Voice
episodes.overview: In the wake of the showdown, the now-disbanded Task Force members continue to seek answers. As the Dark Hearts mobilize to cover their tracks, a shocking revelation leads them to a final confrontation.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: In season 1, FBI agent Tom Brandis heads a task force formed to track down a crew of masked robbers in the Philadelphia area, led by a working-class family man.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: In season 2, Tom Brandis takes the helm of a new task force, but the deeper the operation runs, the harder it is to tell who’s the target.
